description:
Cabo Cruiser Elite 48 Volt Electric Bicycle
X-Treme's all new Cabo Cruiser Elite 48 Volt Electric Bicycle comes standard with a large 500 watt brushless rear hub motor. The motor is installed in the center of the rear wheel and the e-bike is powered by four 48 volt high power batteries (12 AMPS each battery) that will last 3 years or more & can be re-charged more than 500 times. The electric bicycle will travel 20-25 miles on a single charge.
The Cabo Cruiser Elite is a great tool for commuters or those working on large campuses. The pedals are included free but do not need to be installed. The Cabo Cruiser Elite is classified as a power assisted bicycle and is legal most everywhere with no license needed to ride.
Since local and state laws may vary, we recommend that you check with your local DMV for restrictions and guidelines to operating this unit in case they have special provisions which overrule the Federal Bicycle Law.
